verdict.rationale: The docs show a one-line scaffold command (`npm create cloudflare@latest my-app`) and say Wrangler, the official CLI, covers creating, developing and deploying Workers. However, nothing in the evidence shows that one command both scaffolds and deploys, so deploying appears to be a separate Wrangler step. Missing for 10: evidence that the create command also deploys (or one end-to-end scaffold-and-deploy command), documentation of the actual deploy command and flow, and hands-on corroboration of the workflow.
